member.name: T:Jellyfin.Plugin.Estadisticas.Services.PlaybackTrackerService
member.summary:
Background hosted service that subscribes to Jellyfin playback events and records each valid play (after the 20-second threshold) into the plugin's own SQLite database.
Only audio items are tracked. The plugin never writes to Jellyfin's database.
Tracking logic: - On PlaybackStart: create a per-session tracker (keyed by user+item). - On PlaybackProgress: if position ticks >= 20s AND not already recorded for this session, insert a row into `plays`, mark the tracker as recorded. - On PlaybackStop: clean up the tracker.
A "session" here is a single user+item pair; if the same user plays the same song twice (back-to-back), each play counts separately because the tracker is reset on stop.

member.name: T:Jellyfin.Plugin.Estadisticas.Services.PlaylistSchedulerService
member.summary:
Manages the `scheduled_playlists` table: CRUD + due-time evaluation.
The actual publishing is done by ; this service only decides WHICH entries are due and WHICH ItemIds to put in them.
Schedule semantics (server local time, NOT UTC): - Daily: every day at TimeOfDay - Weekly: on DayOfWeek (0=Mon..6=Sun) at TimeOfDay - Monthly: on DayOfMonth (1..28; 29-31 are clamped to 28 to avoid skipped months) at TimeOfDay - Yearly: on MonthAndDay (MM-DD) at TimeOfDay
next_run is computed in UTC for easy comparison with DateTime.UtcNow.
